column1: # Tolbi indoors during Colosso finals: merchants, missing Babi, his unexplained absence, lighthouse rumors, family/work conversations.

column3: The finals are here. Only a\nfew more days to earn what\nwe can from the crowd.{end_wait}
They delayed the festival.\nMore days to sell food and\nbeds? I'm not complaining.{end_wait}
I made more money than ever\nthis week. So why is my\npurse nearly empty?{end_wait}
I saw Babi with my own\neyes. For someone his age,\nhe doesn't look ready to{page_break}slow down.{end_wait}
Are we making more money\nbecause the festival went\non longer? I can't tell{page_break}anymore.{end_wait}
They extended Colosso? No\none told me! I've been\nplanning for the old{page_break}schedule.{end_wait}
I can't afford this room. I\nkeep hoping the owner won't\nask for payment until{page_break}tomorrow.{end_wait}
When Babi watches the\nfinals, the whole arena\nseems to hold its breath.{end_wait}
I'm in Tolbi for the\nfinals, and I'm stuck\nwatching somebody's house.{end_wait}
Someone else could watch\nthe house for an hour. Why\nam I the only one who has{page_break}to stay?{end_wait}
I'm leaving for the finals.\nCome back later if you need\nanything.{end_wait}
We're going to see the\nfinals! I can hardly\nbelieve it!{end_wait}
The finals have started!\nHurry, or you'll miss the\nbest matches.{end_wait}
We missed the trials, so\nI've been looking forward\nto these finals all week.{end_wait}
Babi showed up at the\nfinals after all. Were the\nrumors about him being{page_break}missing wrong?{end_now}
He's at the colosseum now.\nPerhaps everyone worried\nover nothing.{end_wait}
They were searching for\nBabi yesterday. Now he's at\nthe finals? Someone ought{page_break}to explain that.{end_wait}
Babi's finally at Colosso?\nGood. I was beginning to\nwonder if he'd left Tolbi{page_break}for good.{end_wait}
If Babi was never missing,\nwhy were his soldiers\nsearching every street?{end_wait}
Maybe the trials exhaust\nhim. He's older than any\nman I know.{end_wait}
Babi must have a reason for\nthat lighthouse. I just\nwish he'd tell us what it{page_break}is.{end_wait}
I heard Babi has been\nsending men far out to sea.\nWhat could he be looking{page_break}for?{end_wait}
Babi sent ships searching\nbefore he began the\nlighthouse. I don't think{page_break}that's a coincidence.{end_wait}
Babi keeps talking as\nthough he doesn't have much\ntime left. No one seems to{page_break}know what he means.{end_wait}
The finals have started.\nOnce they're over, maybe\nthings will quiet down{page_break}enough to do business.{end_wait}
The fighters buy gear after\nevery match. I can hardly\nkeep the shelves stocked.{end_wait}
We've sold more healing\nherbs this week than in a\nmonth. Those matches must{page_break}be brutal.{end_wait}
I've seen fighters leave\nthe arena barely able to\nstand, then come back for{page_break}another match.{end_wait}
I might shut the shop\nearly. The finals only\nhappen once a year.{end_wait}
If Mother finds out I went\nto Colosso, I'll be\ngrounded until next year.{end_wait}
The moment the finals\nbegin, everyone suddenly\nhas errands outside.{end_wait}
Nobody is leaving work\nearly for Colosso this\nyear. At least not while{page_break}I'm watching.{end_wait}
My wife knows when I'm\nthinking of sneaking off to\nthe finals. I haven't found{page_break}a way past her yet.{end_wait}
I thought everyone wanted\nto see the finals. Maybe\nsome people just prefer a{page_break}quiet day.{end_wait}
Every time I hear the crowd\ncheering, I want to run\nover and see what's{page_break}happened.{end_wait}
Colosso is almost over. The\ntown will feel empty when\nthe visitors leave.{end_wait}
The finals are starting.\nShall we go together?{end_wait}
Next year I'll choose my\nfighter after watching the\ntrials. I won't guess{page_break}blindly again.{end_wait}
I'm the one who wants to\nleave work early. I just\nhaven't dared say so.{end_wait}
Once the house is quiet, I\nthink everyone will find an\nexcuse to visit the arena.{end_wait}
If the master sneaks out,\nthe lady will be furious.\nThat might be our chance to{page_break}slip away too.{end_wait}
If the men leave to watch\nColosso, who do you think\nwill do their work? The{page_break}rest of us.{end_wait}
The master still hasn't\nleft? The lady must be\nwatching him closely this{page_break}year.{end_wait}
I don't enjoy the fighting\nmuch. Still, I'll miss all\nthe noise when Colosso{page_break}ends.{end_wait}
I'd rather watch the\nmatches than hear everyone\ntalk about the winner{page_break}afterward.{end_wait}
Those trials were harder\nthan I expected. I might go\nand see the finals after{page_break}all.{end_wait}
The finals are almost over.\nIf you want to see Colosso,\nyou'd better go now.{end_wait}
You're not interested in\nthe finals? Want to trade\nplaces with me? I'll gladly{page_break}go in your stead.{end_wait}
